messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: You may report side effects to FDA at 1-800-FDA-1088.
Triplet: ["Apixaban", "has reporting contact", "FDA at 1-800-FDA-1088"]

The relation 'has reporting contact' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug has a designated contact entity specified by the object for reporting side effects or adverse events.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
B. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
C. 'may be used for': The subject drug may be used for the purpose or condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'manufactured by': The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.
E. 'has related treatment guide': The subject drug is associated with the medical treatment guide specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
